title: The Roadside Shrine
text: A little shrine to no saint you know, its carving worn smooth by weather and hands. It is kept clean by no one you can see. There are fresh flowers on it, still wet with dew, though nothing grows for miles.

options.label: Kneel together before the nameless saint, and hope it is kind.

outcomes.text: Nothing answers, but you all stand up lucky, and no one says it aloud for fear of losing it.
Nothing answers. But kneeling there among the fresh flowers your legs rest, and your wounds stop their aching.

options.label: The bravest takes the fresh flowers, curious what keeps them alive.

outcomes.text: They keep for a year without wilting, and so does the one who carries them.
They wilt at once, and so does something in the one who took them, and it does not come back.

options.label: The Knight keeps vigil at it through the night, as knights once did.

outcomes.text: No saint answers. The vigil is its own answer, and the Knight rises from it hard as the shrine's stones.
